name: netsleep
description: A sleep inside netintr, on the one network stack a second entry would overwrite, panics by name. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 3.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; echo NOT''REACHED

requires.reason: the sleeping hook is compiled in only at kernel.netprobe = 3
